sn35.104:1.2: “Bhikkhus, I will teach you a Dhamma exposition on the theme of the one who declares the exertion to become secure from bondage.
sn35.104:1.4: “And what, bhikkhus, is the Dhamma exposition on the theme of the one who declares the exertion to become secure from bondage?
sn35.104:1.5: There are, bhikkhus, forms cognizable by the eye that are desirable, lovely, agreeable, pleasing, sensually enticing, tantalizing.
sn35.104:1.6: These have been abandoned by the Tathagata, cut off at the root, made like a palm stump, obliterated so that they are no more subject to future arising.
sn35.104:1.7: He declares an exertion should be made for their abandoning. Therefore the Tathagata is called one who declares the exertion to become secure from bondage.
sn35.104:1.8: “There are, bhikkhus, sounds cognizable by the ear … mental phenomena cognizable by the mind that are desirable, lovely, agreeable, pleasing, sensually enticing, tantalizing.
sn35.104:1.9: These have been abandoned by the Tathagata, cut off at the root, made like a palm stump, obliterated so that they are no more subject to future arising.
sn35.104:1.10: He declares an exertion should be made for their abandoning. Therefore the Tathagata is called one who declares the exertion to become secure from bondage.
sn35.104:1.11: “This, bhikkhus, is the Dhamma exposition on the theme of the one who declares the exertion to become secure from bondage.”
